purpose: Define materially different plausible reality-world families before any C0/C1/N1/PEER evaluation. No single truth world is declared correct. Success is robustness/falsification across prespecified world families, not recovery of a candidate-aligned generator.

calibration_bindings.rule: Archive supports ranges/support and class/regime conditioning only; it does not define population-exact probabilities or causal tactical coefficients.

shared_reality_constraints_across_all_wo: Race regime/grade/class/field size must be explicitly bound before generation.
Venue geometry must come from official master/officially supported venue geometry, not W0-W4 engineering frequencies.
Persistent rider identity must exist across simulated time when longitudinal claims are made.
Competition score and historical rates are historical PRE state variables, not direct latent sensors.
No historical PRE value may be sourced after its decision cutoff.
Line state may be PRE_EVENT_EXPECTED_LINE, LEGSHOW_OBSERVED_LINE or unavailable; POST_RACE_RECONSTRUCTED_LINE is prohibited as PRE.
Physics/tactics parameters may not be selected from C0/C1/N1/PEER performance.
RESULT/PAYOUT and protected validation remain closed.

world_families.line_mechanism: No latent same-line arithmetic-mean uplift. Cooperation effect is limited to physically plausible local drafting/position interactions with weak tactical persistence.
world_families.purpose: Falsify models that only work when strong stable line truth is injected.

world_families.line_mechanism: Front-to-rear aerodynamic/position interaction and role-asymmetric costs/benefits. No symmetric line-average utility term.
world_families.purpose: Test reality-plausible directional line interaction without W1 arithmetic-mean truth.

world_families.line_mechanism: Line affiliation matters through state transitions such as bante following, blocking/defense, switching and competition for position rather than a shared scalar ability uplift.
world_families.purpose: Separate relational tactics from simple peer-score or same-line mean constructs.

world_families.line_mechanism: Expected/observed line state can fragment, switch, detach or become solo during the race.
world_families.purpose: Falsify architectures that assume line membership remains structurally stable throughout the outcome process.

world_families.line_mechanism: Same tactical family is evaluated across official 333/335/400/500m track regimes with geometry-conditioned physical costs; indoor/no-wind and outdoor weather states remain distinct.
world_families.purpose: Prevent a single bank-length/geometry regime from defining the world.

world_families.line_mechanism: Line/tactics coexist with persistent rider form/effort/fatigue uncertainty across time.
world_families.purpose: Test whether structural gains survive once rider state is not iid race-by-race.

point_values_allowed_now: officially sourced static venue geometry when sourceable
captured point-in-time PRE values for the specific captured observation
forbidden_point_truth: W1 coefficient 0.16 as reality line effect
W2 same-line/follower/chain coefficients as reality truth
any coefficient selected because PEER/N1/C1/C0 performs well
population-exact frequencies inferred from the 248-observation convenience archive alone

physics_fusion_rule.reason: Research requires auditable equations, ranges and tactical transitions more than rendering or full rigid-body simulation.

future_evaluation_contract_not_yet_autho.primary_success_rule: No candidate may be called reality-supported merely by winning one world; robustness and failure pattern across materially different prespecified worlds would be required.
future_evaluation_contract_not_yet_autho.matched_oracle_controls: Allowed only if separately labeled ENGINEERING/ORACLE_LIKE and excluded from reality evidence.
no_rescue: No world removal because a candidate loses.
No truth coefficient retuning after candidate results.
No feature tournament or coefficient sweep under this design gate.
No extra reality data selected because it favors a candidate.

known_gaps_before_execution: Numeric physics parameter ranges are not yet frozen for Japanese keirin riders.
Decision-time mutable line transport remains unresolved for broad prospective collection.
Weather/wind point-in-time transport is not yet standardized.
333/335m race-level PRE calibration observations are not yet in the current private archive.
Longitudinal repeated observations of the same anonymized rider are not yet sufficiently structured for transition calibration.
Tactical transition effect ranges remain intentionally unknown.
